product_metadata.title: Tulip Baking Cups - Striped Tulip Baking Paper Cupcake & Muffin Liners Pack of 150 | Grease resistant Wrappers by Baker’s Signature – Will Not Curl or Burn – Non-Toxic & Comes in Convenient Packaging
features: ✔️ BEAUTIFUL TOUCH FOR YOUR BAKING –Looking to add a beautiful, finished look to your muffins or cupcakes? Your search is finally over. Our grease resistant baking cups will not only add an elegant and unique feel to your baked goods, they will take the hassle out your baking. No more wasting time cutting and folding parchment paper our cups are already precut and ready to go leaving you with just one thing to do – let your delicious recipes come to life!

✔️ CONVENIENT PACKAGING & SIZE – Baker’s Signature cups come in a convenient box that is easy to store without folding or tearing. The box will maintain the baking cups’ perfect shape and freshness until next baking time. With a bottom of 2 inches in diameter, our tulip baking cups fit into a standard muffin or cupcake pan. The cups’ height is 2.2 in at the low point and to 3.2 in at the high point with capacity of 3 Oz making it the perfect choice for baking.

✔️ THE RIGHT CUPS FOR BAKING YOUR FAVORITES - Our cups are grease resistant, waterproof, and non-toxic; they will not tear, rip or soak through. They withstand temperatures up to 220°C/425°F, which is higher than most recipes require. Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, Halloween, Christmas as well as other parties and events.

✔️ HEALTHY ALTERNATIVE – Made from natural 100% wood pulp, our baking cups are a much healthier alternative to Quilon based products. Quilon contains a chemical called Chromium that can be harmful once ingested. Do you love baking but hate cleaning up? Make cleanup easier than ever. Our white, brown and natural colored cups perfectly all standard sized muffin and cupcake baking pans so that you are covered when things get messy.

✔️ YOUR 100 % SATISFACTION, GUARANTEED – At Baker’s Signature we take customer satisfaction very seriously. If for ANY reason our cupcake and muffin liners don’t live up to your expectations, let us know and we will make sure that the things are made right. Our products are crafted by trusted artisans from carefully selected materials that have been sourced only from approved suppliers. Quality is our priority. Get your baking paper cups today and enjoy hassle free baking for the years to come!
